name: ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1

function.text: ARIH1 is the approved symbol for ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ISG15 ligase activity; ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding; PKR/eIFalpha signaling.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. function.text: ARIH1 encodes ariadne RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1. It is an E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase, which catalyzes ubiquitination of target proteins together with ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2 UBE2L3. It functions as an atypical E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase by working together with cullin-RING ubiquitin ligase (CRL) complexes and initiating ubiquitination of CRL substrates: associates with CRL complexes and specifically mediates addition of the first ubiquitin on CRLs targets. The initial ubiquitin is then elongated by CDC34/UBE2R1 and UBE2R2.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARIH1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
